title: ack
description: Topic {prefix}/{robot_id}/task/{task_id}/ack, ROS to HA, QoS 1, retained, message expiry reply.ack_expiry_s (default 120). One distinct ack per command id; a repeated id republishes the stored ack bytes. accepted is true exactly when code is 'accepted'. For type cancel, an accepted ack is the terminal outcome of that command id. A command whose id is not a UUID gets no ack at all.

type.description: The type of the command being acknowledged.

task.description: The task named by the command, or null for a cancel or when the command was too malformed to tell.

received_at.description: Node clock when the command arrived.

clock_skew_ms.description: received_at minus the command's issued_at, or null when issued_at could not be read.
